description: Structured eval definitions for the Macie Data Classifier. Five-case proven set exercising the CLASSIFIED / PARTIALLY_CLASSIFIED / UNCLASSIFIED classification across Macie postures (healthy full-coverage, partial ASDD-only gap, unclassified Macie disabled, dangerous broad suppression rule masking findings, missing multi-account member coverage). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Healthy Macie posture with full coverage and narrow suppression rules
eval_cases.branch: CLASSIFIED — Macie enabled, ASDD on with auto-enable, daily scheduled jobs for high-sensitivity buckets, custom identifiers with healthy regex, narrow suppression rules, Security Hub export enabled, full multi-account coverage
eval_cases.prompt: Audit the Macie data classification posture for account 123456789012 in us-east-1. Macie is enabled with FIFTEEN_MINUTES frequency. ASDD is enabled with auto enable for org members. There are 4 classification jobs (1 one-time, 3 scheduled daily) scoping 28 sensitive S3 buckets with 12 non-sensitive excluded. Coverage: 120 total buckets, 108 ASDD, 28 deep-scan, 12 unmonitored (low-risk logs). Managed identifiers set to ALL. 3 custom identifiers (employee ID, internal API key, proprietary format) with word boundaries and ignore-words. 12/12 high-sensitivity buckets have full-scan daily jobs. Findings last 30d: 2 High (triaged), 8 Medium, 15 Low (archived). 4 suppression rules (1 SUPPRESS for known-public-bucket, 3 ARCHIVE). 148/150 org accounts enrolled. Security Hub export enabled. EventBridge rule active with Lambda remediation target.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MACIE_CLASSIFICATION: 123456789012 (us-east-1) — ENABLED
VERDICT: CLASSIFIED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Macie session: ENABLED
  [✓] Automated discovery (ASDD): ENABLED
  [✓] ASDD auto-enable members: true
  [✓] Classification jobs: 4 (one-time: 1, scheduled: 3)
  [✓] High-sensitivity deep-scan: 12/12 buckets
  [✓] Custom identifiers: 3 (scored: 3/0/0)
  [✓] Suppression rules: 4 (SUPPRESS: 1, ARCHIVE: 3)
  [✓] Multi-account: 148/150 accounts enrolled
  [✓] Security Hub export: ENABLED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws macie2 get-macie-session --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Partial Macie posture with ASDD-only coverage gap and Security Hub export disabled
eval_cases.branch: PARTIALLY_CLASSIFIED — Macie enabled and ASDD on, but only one-time jobs, 7/12 high-sensitivity buckets ASDD-only, custom identifier with bad regex, Security Hub export disabled, no EventBridge rule
eval_cases.prompt: Audit the Macie data classification posture for account 123456789012 in us-east-1. Macie is enabled with FIFTEEN_MINUTES frequency. ASDD is enabled but autoEnableOrganizationMembers is false. There are 2 classification jobs — both one-time, zero scheduled. Job scoping: 10 buckets included, 0 excluded. Coverage: 120 total buckets, 85 ASDD, 10 deep-scan, 35 unmonitored. Managed identifiers RECOMMENDED. 1 custom identifier with regex \d{1,19} (no word boundaries, no ignore-words). Only 5/12 high-sensitivity buckets have full-scan. Security Hub export is DISABLED. No EventBridge rule.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MACIE_CLASSIFICATION: 123456789012 (us-east-1) — ENABLED
VERDICT: PARTIALLY_CLASSIFIED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Macie session: ENABLED
  [✓] Automated discovery (ASDD): ENABLED
  [✗] ASDD auto-enable members: false
  [✗] Classification jobs: 2 (one-time: 2, scheduled: 0)
  [✗] High-sensitivity deep-scan: 5/12 buckets
  [✗] Custom identifiers: 1 (scored: 0/0/1 — high risk)
  [✗] Security Hub export: DISABLED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws macie2 get-macie-session --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Macie not enabled in the account
eval_cases.branch: UNCLASSIFIED — Macie session does not exist, no jobs, no identifiers, zero coverage
eval_cases.prompt: Audit the Macie data classification posture for account 123456789012 in us-east-1. When checking with aws macie2 get-macie-session, Macie returns a not-found error. Macie has never been enabled in this account. There are 80 S3 buckets with unknown data classification. No classification jobs exist. No custom identifiers exist.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MACIE_CLASSIFICATION: 123456789012 (us-east-1) — NOT_ENABLED
VERDICT: UNCLASSIFIED
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Macie session: NOT_ENABLED
  [✗] Automated discovery (ASDD): DISABLED
  [✗] Classification jobs: 0
  [✗] Coverage gap: 80 buckets unmonitored
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws macie2 get-macie-session --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Dangerous broad suppression rule masking all High and Medium findings
eval_cases.branch: PARTIALLY_CLASSIFIED — jobs and ASDD healthy, but a SUPPRESS filter on all High+Medium severity findings masks everything from Security Hub
eval_cases.prompt: Audit the Macie data classification posture for account 123456789012 in us-east-1. Macie is enabled. ASDD is enabled. 3 classification jobs scoping 20 buckets. Coverage looks good: 20 buckets deep-scanned daily. 2 custom identifiers (healthy regex). However, there are 2 suppression rules — one has action SUPPRESS with criteria matching ALL findings of severity High and Medium. This means all High and Medium findings are suppressed before reaching Security Hub. Security Hub shows zero Macie findings despite jobs running daily.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MACIE_CLASSIFICATION: 123456789012 (us-east-1) — ENABLED
VERDICT: PARTIALLY_CLASSIFIED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Macie session: ENABLED
  [✓] Automated discovery (ASDD): ENABLED
  [✗] Suppression rules: 2 (SUPPRESS: 1, ARCHIVE: 1)
  [✗] Suppression scope: BROAD (1 SUPPRESS filters all High+Medium severity — red flag)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws macie2 list-findings-filters --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Multi-account Macie with 55 unmonitored accounts and 5 paused members
eval_cases.branch: PARTIALLY_CLASSIFIED — admin account healthy but only 95/150 org accounts enrolled, 5 members PAUSED, 2 INVITED never accepted, ASDD auto-enable false
eval_cases.prompt: Audit the Macie data classification posture for the organization with administrator account 123456789012 in us-east-1. Macie is enabled in the admin account. ASDD is enabled. Classification jobs cover all sensitive buckets in the admin account. Security Hub export is enabled. However, when listing members, only 95 of 150 organization accounts are enrolled in Macie. Of those 95, 5 are in PAUSED status and 2 are in INVITED status (never accepted). ASDD autoEnableOrganizationMembers is false.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MACIE_CLASSIFICATION: 123456789012 (us-east-1) — ENABLED
VERDICT: PARTIALLY_CLASSIFIED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Macie session: ENABLED
  [✗] ASDD auto-enable members: false
  [✗] Multi-account: 88/150 accounts effectively covered (55 unenrolled + 5 PAUSED + 2 INVITED)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws macie2 list-members --region us-east-1
